usage.callShape: POST https://x402.nichospt.net/render with JSON body {html, options?} where html is a full HTML document string; returns raw application/pdf bytes
usage.outputShape: Raw binary response body = the PDF file itself (Content-Type: application/pdf). No JSON wrapper; write the response bytes directly to a .pdf file.
quirks: Despite the name 'Render' and subcategory 'screenshot-rendering', this is an HTML-to-PDF converter, NOT a screenshot/image renderer and NOT a URL renderer.
Input takes {html} (a full HTML document string, required, maxLength 2000000) — it does NOT accept a {url}. To render a live page you must fetch its HTML yourself first.
Response is RAW binary PDF (application/pdf), not JSON. Save response bytes straight to a .pdf file; do not JSON.parse.
Optional {options:{format:'A4'|'Letter', landscape:bool, margin}} control page layout (defaults A4, portrait).
Paid $0.005 USDC on Base (eip155:8453); also accepts Solana and Polygon per payment.accepts.
usage.guide: POST https://x402.nichospt.net/render with a JSON body {"html":"<full html doc>"} and pay the $0.005 x402 quote (Base USDC by default). The html field is required and is the document to render — this is HTML-to-PDF, not a screenshot tool and not a URL fetcher, so if you want a live web page, fetch its HTML first and pass it in. Optionally add {"options":{"format":"A4","landscape":false}}. The response is raw application/pdf bytes — write the body directly to a .pdf file; there is no JSON envelope.
